column3: Sets sun and moon in measured order, against which their gathering marks disrupted distinction.
Offers only a secondary sight-without-seeing parallel to the surrounding visual shock.
Places a gathered, witnessed Last Day beside the cosmic gathering.
Its gathering and enclosing supplies a non-celestial model of concentration.
The preceding dazzled gaze frames the sun-moon gathering as a scene of optical upheaval.
Names night, day, sun, and moon as created signs, preserving their ordered distinction before the event.
Shows sun and moon in continual service, contrasting their later forced conjunction.
The darkened moon immediately precedes and sharpens the gathering of the two lights.
Keeps the moon as a visible celestial sign, though without the conjunction.
Presents sun and moon as subjected, so their gathering remains within divine command.
The ensuing search for escape gives the cosmic gathering its human crisis.
Only a remote, collective sense of all on earth; it adds little to the celestial scene.
Sets sun and moon on separate appointed courses within night-day alternation.
Its guiding star offers a loose contrast between ordinary celestial orientation and the scene's disruption.
Distinguishes moon as light and sun as lamp, clarifying the two bodies gathered.
Shows the two bodies moving to fixed terms through the night-day alternation.
The grim faces later in the passage extend the event's human consequence.
Supplies the sun's public brightness as a contrast to the collapse of normal illumination.
Shows an all-inclusive gathering, but in a different collective setting.
Self-witnessing is only a secondary counterpart to the passage's overwhelmed vision.
A self-described united body offers a secondary, non-celestial sense of gathering.
Makes a shared appointed destination a parallel for gathering disparate followers.
The denial of refuge directly continues the crisis opened by the cosmic signs.
Its total engulfing of a people is only a distant image of comprehensive gathering.
Preserves a whole group together in rescue, a secondary sense of complete collectivity.
Restored sight is a limited contrary parallel to the passage's visual disturbance.
The sun's setting tests even the greatest visible light as transient, supporting its creaturely status.
Uses gathering within the same surah as preservation and ordered recitation, a parallel but distinct sense.
The expected calamity on faces continues the human response to the preceding cosmic signs.
Explicitly gathers people for an unquestioned day, paralleling the event's final-day horizon.
Joins the approaching Hour to a rupture involving the moon.
The same surah's gathering of bones parallels reconstitution of what has been dispersed.
Links life, death, and gathering to the Day of Resurrection.
Contrasts divine gathering with a person's gathering and counting of wealth.
A gathered plan and associates give only a secondary collective-reading parallel.
Its movement into a gathered mass is a limited, non-celestial concentration image.
Contrasts darkness and light, supporting the passage's concern with altered illumination.
Names the Resurrection Day that governs the immediate sequence of cosmic signs.
Gathers earlier and later generations at a known appointed time.
Relates the moon to the sun in ordered succession, preserving a relevant parallel reading.
The final settlement with the Lord supplies the destination after the failed flight.
Shows sun and moon together in a dream's relational order, a secondary parallel to their conjunction.
A defeated gathering offers a contrary, non-celestial collective outcome.
Its fulfillment scene does not materially clarify the sun-moon gathering.
A sunless setting is only a remote contrast to the passage's disturbed lights.
The sun is folded up, closely paralleling cosmic transformation and concentration.
Looking toward the Lord is a secondary visual parallel, not an account of the celestial event.
An all-inclusive gathering for questioning provides a final-day parallel.
The full moon depicts lunar phases reaching visible completeness, a secondary gathering image.
The self-reproaching soul does not clarify the sun-moon gathering.
Keeps a household together in rescue, a secondary form of complete gathering.
The oath by time adds no focused link to the two celestial bodies' gathering.
The storm-and-ash comparison does not clarify this celestial conjunction.
Uses the sun's course to distinguish divine power from a human claim.
Gives the moon measured stations, contrasting regular lunar order with the event.
Radiant faces later in the passage offer only a secondary light-and-vision parallel.
Complete household rescue supplies a non-celestial parallel of gathering without loss.
Dawn offers a loose illumination contrast, without addressing sun and moon together.
The question of being left without purpose adds no focused link here.
The statement of all divine might is only a broad authority parallel.
Names sun and moon each swimming in an orbit, the clearest contrast to their gathering.
Unceasing night-day praise is only a remote parallel to ordered celestial time.
States power to gather creatures scattered through heavens and earth.
Pairs sun and moon with calculated measure and the night, defining normal celestial order.
Turning away later in the passage only indirectly follows the scene's judgment.
Contrasts amassed possessions with mercy, a distant alternate sense of gathering.
Lists night, day, sun, moon, and stars as subjected by command.
The person's departure to family does not clarify the celestial gathering.
An entire people drowned together supplies only a secondary comprehensive outcome.
Places sun and moon among beings submitting, reinforcing their non-independent status.
Combines restored sight with the gathering of the family, a secondary visual and collective parallel.
The moon's rising and setting tests its visible brilliance as dependent and transient.
Places sun and moon on appointed courses under governance, contrasting their conjunction.
The pairing of male and female does not clarify the celestial pair.
Brings what is in heavens and earth under one source and service, a broad ordered-totality parallel.
The sunrise scene concerns terrestrial exposure, not the sun-moon gathering.
Day as seeing offers a limited illumination parallel to the passage's shocked sight.
An attempted ransom with all earthly things gives only a distant totality image.
Distinguishes sun as radiance and moon as light within measured lunar stations.
Lightning nearly taking sight provides a visual-shock parallel to the preceding dazzled gaze.
A full destination for followers gives a secondary image of all-inclusive collection.
Shows sun and moon running to appointed terms through night-day alternation.
An ordered, complete creation is only a broad parallel to cosmic reconfiguration.
Insists that sun cannot overtake moon and each moves in an orbit, directly contrasting their gathering.
Gathers earlier and later people for the Day of Decision.
The setting-sun scene supplies only an isolated solar image.
The collective descent and guidance do not clarify the celestial event.
Sunrise and sunset preserve the ordinary temporal bounds later overturned in the scene.
A claimed united force is defeated, a contrary secondary reading of gathering.
Sets sun, moon, stars, night, and day under a single command.
The return of all affairs to God adds no focused account of sun and moon.
A gathered day exposes and separates claimed partners, paralleling final judgment.
Mutual sight and a retreating force offer only a remote visual and collective parallel.
Raises all and recounts every deed, making gathering an exhaustive reckoning.
Scattered carpets do not clarify the celestial conjunction.
Successive communities meet together in the Fire, a secondary final gathering.
Returns all to God for disclosure of differences, a broad judgment-day parallel.
Eating together or separately gives only a mundane, secondary sense of gathering.
Lowered sight and collective return are distant visual and collective parallels.
Contrasts joy in grace with what people accumulate, a distant alternate sense of gathering.
The moon's changing phases establish a measured lunar order and public timing, contrasting its gathered state.
The sun's decline marks an ordinary temporal boundary, a secondary contrast to the cosmic disruption.
The sun's passing direction supplies an isolated image of its regular motion.
The sun functions as an indicator within ordinary visibility, contrasting the scene's disturbed light.
Pairs a celestial lamp with an illuminating moon, clarifying their distinct luminous roles before gathering.
The sun's worship by a people provides a contrary reading that the celestial body is not independent of divine judgment.
Sets the sun running toward an appointed resting point, directly contrasting normal course with conjunction.
A further moon sign and the refusal to receive it extend the cosmic-sign horizon of 75:9.
